pages.text: This Furnace uses Forge Energy instead of fuel. It accepts the same smelting recipes as a vanilla furnace and respects the recipe’s output amount. It stores 1 million FE and a base job takes 1,000 FE and five seconds.

pages.title: Upgrades and Automation
pages.text: Connect item automation to feed input and extract output. A dedicated slot takes speed upgrades. For each upgrade in the stack the energy cost rises by 1,000 FE.$(br2)Make sure the result fits and enough FE is buffered before starting a batch.
